def simulate_game(N):
    cards = list(range(1, N + 1))
    s1 = 0
    s2 = 0
    
    print(f"Starting simulation for N={N}. Total sum: {N*(N+1)//2}")

    for k in range(N):
        # Both players always choose the largest available card (most common heuristic for such games)
        C = max(cards)
        cards.remove(C)
        
        is_grogg_turn = (k % 2 == 0)
        
        if is_grogg_turn:
            # Grogg wants to minimize |S1 - S2|
            
            # Option 1: Place in Pile 1
            d1 = abs((s1 + C) - s2)
            # Option 2: Place in Pile 2
            d2 = abs(s1 - (s2 + C))
            
            if d1 <= d2:
                s1 += C
                # print(f"Turn {k+1} (G): Chose {C}. Put in P1. S1={s1}, S2={s2}. Diff={d1}")
            else:
                s2 += C
                # print(f"Turn {k+1} (G): Chose {C}. Put in P2. S1={s1}, S2={s2}. Diff={d2}")
        else:
            # Winnie wants to maximize |S1 - S2|
            
            # Option 1: Place in Pile 1
            d1 = abs((s1 + C) - s2)
            # Option 2: Place in Pile 2
            d2 = abs(s1 - (s2 + C))
            
            if d1 >= d2:
                s1 += C
                # print(f"Turn {k+1} (W): Chose {C}. Put in P1. S1={s1}, S2={s2}. Diff={d1}")
            else:
                s2 += C
                # print(f"Turn {k+1} (W): Chose {C}. Put in P2. S1={s1}, S2={s2}. Diff={d2}")

    final_difference = abs(s1 - s2)
    print(f"Final sums: S1={s1}, S2={s2}")
    print(f"Final difference achieved: {final_difference}")
    return final_difference

# Run for N=50
N_cards = 50
result = simulate_game(N_cards)
